objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Use the SQL injection module of the coffee shop to read the flag stored in the flags table of the application's database.
hints: The SQL Injection - Error Based module builds its query from the item and search fields.
Once the query is yours, the database's own catalogue lists every table: look for one that has nothing to do with coffee.

steps.title: Find the input
steps.prompt: Which form parameter of the SQL injection module is placed in the query without quotes around it?

steps.title: Identify the database
steps.prompt: Which database server family answers the queries? (name only)

steps.title: Pick the technique
steps.prompt: Which SQL operator lets you append the rows of another table to the product listing?

steps.title: Enumerate the tables
steps.prompt: Which built-in schema describes every table and column of the server?
